title: Cache expired within an hour (five-minute lifetime in effect)
source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/prompt-caching (five-minute and one-hour TTLs; promptCacheTtl / CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL take 5m or 1h; one-hour cache writes cost more). Replaces the spec's ttl-regression, whose version claim is unverified.

fix.text: Rebuilds after pauses of 5 to 60 minutes mean those requests had the five-minute cache lifetime. If you pause like that often, set promptCacheTtl to 1h (settings, or CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL). The API bills one-hour cache writes at a higher rate, so it only pays off if you regularly come back within the hour.
